en-US.description: The complete suite of desktop apps for power users who need access to study setup and administration.
en-US.longDescription: DFdiscover is our complete suite of desktop apps for power users who need access to study setup and administration. It includes: DFexplore, DFsetup, DFadmin, DFsend, DFbarcode, DFATK + command-line tools (DFattach, DFaudittrace, DFbatch, DFexport, DFpass, DFpdfpkg, DFreport, DFuserPerms).
en-US.name: DFdiscover

zh-CN.description: 专为有研究项目设置及管理需求的高级用户打造的全套桌面应用套件
